name: Zscaler export analytics, policy review and experience score rules

case: zs-an-threat-allowed positive: threat-flagged transaction allowed
zs-an-threat-allowed negative: same threat blocked
zs-an-sandbox-allowed positive: sandbox-flagged file allowed
zs-an-sandbox-allowed negative: sandbox verdict blocked
zs-an-blocked-then-allowed positive: blocked then allowed ten minutes later
zs-an-blocked-then-allowed negative: allowed two hours after the block
zs-an-dlp-allowed positive: upload matched a DLP dictionary and was allowed
zs-an-dlp-allowed negative: no DLP match
zs-an-dlp-repeat positive: five DLP blocks by one user
zs-an-dlp-repeat negative: four DLP blocks
zs-an-risky-category-allowed positive: newly registered domain allowed
zs-an-risky-category-allowed negative: news category allowed
zs-an-unsanctioned-saas positive: unsanctioned file-sharing app with a 6 MiB upload
zs-an-unsanctioned-saas negative: sanctioned app with the same upload
zs-an-large-upload positive: 120 MiB sent to one host
zs-an-large-upload negative: 10 MiB sent to one host
zs-an-unscannable-allowed positive: three allowed unscannable transactions
zs-an-unscannable-allowed negative: two
zs-an-zpa-denied-burst positive: ten denied attempts in ten minutes
zs-an-zpa-denied-burst negative: nine denied attempts
zs-an-zpa-app-sweep positive: eight distinct applications in ten minutes
zs-an-zpa-app-sweep negative: seven
zs-an-impossible-travel positive: London then Sydney one hour apart
zs-an-impossible-travel negative: London then Manchester one hour apart
zs-an-off-hours positive: five events between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC
zs-an-off-hours negative: five events at 10:00 UTC
zs-an-bypass-tool positive: anonymiser category allowed
zs-an-bypass-tool negative: anonymiser category blocked
zs-an-dns-tunnel-like positive: twenty long DNS names under one domain
zs-an-dns-tunnel-like negative: nineteen
zs-an-fw-risky-port-allowed positive: RDP allowed to a public address
zs-an-fw-risky-port-allowed negative: RDP allowed to a private address
zspol-url-allow-any positive: allow rule with no scope
zspol-url-allow-any negative: allow rule scoped to a category
zspol-url-risky-allowed positive: allow rule names an anonymiser category
zspol-url-risky-allowed negative: allow rule names a news category
zspol-rule-shadowed positive: block after a universal allow
zspol-rule-shadowed negative: block before the universal allow
zspol-fw-any-any-allow positive: firewall allow with no restrictions
zspol-fw-any-any-allow negative: firewall allow scoped by source, destination and service
zspol-fw-risky-service-allow positive: RDP allowed to any destination
zspol-fw-risky-service-allow negative: RDP allowed to a named destination
zspol-ssl-bypass-broad positive: do-not-decrypt rule covers every category
zspol-ssl-bypass-broad negative: do-not-decrypt rule covers one category
zspol-ssl-inspection-absent positive: only do-not-decrypt rules
zspol-ssl-inspection-absent negative: a decrypt rule exists
zspol-dlp-missing positive: web policy and no DLP rule
zspol-dlp-missing negative: web policy with a blocking DLP rule
zspol-dlp-monitor-only positive: only allow-action DLP rules
zspol-dlp-monitor-only negative: a blocking DLP rule
zspol-app-unsanctioned-allow positive: allow rule names an app outside the sanctioned list
zspol-app-unsanctioned-allow negative: allow rule names a sanctioned app
zspol-rule-stale positive: allow rule last modified in 2020
zspol-rule-stale negative: allow rule modified in September 2026
zspol-zpa-allow-all-apps positive: allow rule with only a user condition
zspol-zpa-allow-all-apps negative: allow rule naming an app group
zspol-zpa-any-user positive: allow rule with only an app condition
zspol-zpa-any-user negative: allow rule with a SCIM group condition
zspol-zpa-no-device-posture positive: allow rule without posture
zspol-zpa-no-device-posture negative: allow rule with a posture condition
zspol-zpa-wildcard-segment positive: segment with a bare wildcard domain
zspol-zpa-wildcard-segment negative: segment with one named domain
zdx-an-poor-experience positive: three probes score Poor
zdx-an-poor-experience negative: three healthy probes
zdx-an-packet-loss positive: five percent packet loss
zdx-an-packet-loss negative: half a percent
zdx-an-dns-slow positive: 300 ms DNS time
zdx-an-dns-slow negative: 20 ms DNS time
zdx-an-device-pressure positive: 95 percent CPU
zdx-an-device-pressure negative: 40 percent CPU
